name: Kasshoku no Hada ni Shiroi Seieki wa Yoku Haeru
original_name: 褐色の肌に白い精液はよくはえる
source:
Girls stained with semen…
At one of the schools, there are two tanned female students.
Both are so well-known that everyone in the school knows their names.
One is an international exchange student, Sora Sharuru.
Her Japanese isn’t as good as she’d hoped, making it hard for her to connect with her classmates.
The other is a sporty girl, Higa Mai.
Known as the school’s shadow boss, she can take down multiple guys at once.
Now, their homeroom teacher wants to teach them a “friendship ritual,” while the guys Mai humiliated are plotting revenge…

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/brown/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
女孩身上沾满精液……
其中一所学校有两名晒黑的女学生。
两人都非常有名，学校里的每个人都知道他们的名字。
其中一位是国际交换生索拉·沙鲁鲁(Sora Sharuru)。
她的日语不如她希望的那么好，这让她很难与同学交流。
另一位是运动型女孩比嘉舞。
她被称为学校的影子老大，可以同时干掉多个人。
现在，班主任要教他们“友谊仪式”，而被麦羞辱的家伙们却在密谋复仇……

[翻译自[url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/brown/story.html]官网[/url]]
